load_esm2_model_from_hub: load a pretrained ESM-2 protein language model by name from the FAIR model hub
load_esm_model_from_local_path: load a pretrained ESM model and alphabet from a local .pt checkpoint file path
load_esmfold_v1_for_structure_prediction: load the ESMFold v1 model for fast atomic-level protein structure prediction from sequence
load_esm1b_best_model: load the ESM-1b 33-layer 650M parameter best-performing model from the pretrained model hub
load_esm1v_ensemble_model: load one of the five ESM-1v 33-layer 650M parameter ensemble models trained on UniRef90
